title: Rubio 'very disturbed' by West Bank settler attacks, urges Israel to crack down
detail: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said he is 'very disturbed' by settler attacks in the West Bank and urged Israel to crack down on settler violence, per a news report surfaced via Google News. Outlet not identified in the feed; details unverified beyond the headline summary.

title: US officials condemn West Bank settler attacks as Netanyahu casts doubt on them
detail: US officials condemned settler attacks on Palestinians in the West Bank, while Prime Minister Netanyahu cast doubt on the reports of the attacks, according to The New York Times. Details beyond the headline summary are unverified.
